details: Searching for zero-copy sharded input CB consumption idiom (cb_descriptor_from_sharded_tensor + cb_wait_front)

Canonical idiom: consumer of a zero-copy sharded input CB must arm the fifo with cb_reserve_back+cb_push_back (NO data read). Two variants: compute self-arms (Python examples reduce_block/sfpu_tile_scope/matmul/row_reduce/compute_block_size/eltwise), or reader NCRISC arms via setup_sharded_buffer helper (deepseek_moe_gate C++). Framework does NOT auto-populate. get_read_ptr-and-skip-wait is NOT used.
